notes: xbox.com Series X page, 'DESIGN > Digital' block (raw HTML, 2026-11-01); the spec table names it 'XBOX Series X – 1TB Digital Edition'. Axis labels from the sketch alt text (standing up, so state 'vertical'; 'breadth' recorded as width). Visible line: 'Dimensions 15.1cm x 15.1cm x 30.1cm'.
media is a covered empty list: the maker calls this console 'all digital', and the spec table's 'Optical Drive.' row lists only the Carbon Black and Galaxy Black editions.
Mass derived from the maker's pounds (453.59237 g/lb).
external_ids: no Wikidata item for the digital edition alone was confirmed; the platform item Q64513817 is on microsoft-xbox-series-x.

ports: the maker's 'PORTS & CONNECTIVITY' block, filed as its complete list: hdmi 1, usb_a 3, ethernet 1. usb_a is our mapping of the maker's 'USB 3.1 Gen 1 ports' (no plug type named), per the coordinator ruling of 2026-11-01. Not in that block and therefore not filed: the power inlet (a 'power cord' is in the box contents) and the storage expansion port (FAQ). The block is shared by every Series X edition on the page.
